assertions.text: Correctly reads review_findings_severity_gate as true and applies the Decline path
States plainly the finding is not fixed and not filed as an issue
States the finding is acknowledged via a reply only
States the thread is left unresolved (not resolved), since it wasn't actually handled
Does not route this to the Fix path just because it's round 1 -- correctly overrides the default round-1 fix behavior with the gate's decline rule
